summary: The statement and proof agree, with no mathematical error or gap found. Checks of the smallest parameter range, zero-volume boundary fibers, median ties, and degenerate halfspace sections reveal no counterexample. The rational polytope descriptions give the complete claimed lattice fiber tables. The explicit ambient halfspaces confine every positive contribution to the stated lattice ball, and the Gaussian lower bound for total mass and the lattice count yield the uniform local-depth estimate with the stated constants. The accepted continuous centroid inequality applies to every positive fiber and to the homothetic inner bodies; together with central symmetry and the weighted median it proves the constant-depth witnesses and their exact local depths. The cube height-median argument, the original even-dimensional estimates, the convex-hull realization, and the dilation assertions are also justified, including all stated parameter thresholds and strict inequalities.
